title: Broward County Clerk of Courts passport offices
fact: Central Courthouse, 201 S.E. 6th Street, Room 01160, Fort Lauderdale: Monday to Friday 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., phone (954) 831-2343. North Regional Courthouse, Deerfield Beach: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., phone (954) 831-1453. South Regional Courthouse, Hollywood: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., phone (954) 831-0320. West Regional Courthouse, Plantation, Room 180: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., phone (954) 831-6528. Closed holidays. The clerk's page says wait times are longer than usual and the line may close as early as 1:00 p.m. while the listed hours stay the same.

title: Palm Beach County Clerk passport services
fact: Appointment required: walk-in customers are not accepted. Appointments at Palm Beach Gardens, Delray Beach, Royal Palm Beach or Belle Glade. Passport photos are $16 each. Veterans, active-duty service members, and reservists get that photo free when they show a military discharge form (DD-214), military identification, or a veteran designation on a driver's license.

title: Miami-Dade Public Library System passport services
fact: North Dade Regional, West Kendall Regional and Naranja Branch libraries accept passport applications by appointment only; one appointment per applicant. Photo service is currently not available. The library's own page lists North Dade Regional Monday hours as 4:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m.

title: City of Coral Gables passport office
fact: Applications are by appointment only. The office is closed Wednesday, 11 November 2026, for Veterans Day, and reopens Thursday, 12 November 2026.

title: City of Miami Beach passport hours
fact: Passport customers are seen Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m., by appointment only.

title: City of Miami Springs passport services
fact: Monday to Friday 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. and Saturday 8:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Appointments are prioritized, and a walk-in may not be served the same day.

title: City of West Miami passport services
fact: Monday to Friday 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., last appointment 3:30 p.m. Tuesday 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., last appointment 5:30 p.m. Appointments are online only. Walk-ins are accepted if a slot is open.

title: City of Miramar passport services
fact: Passport appointments are Monday to Thursday, 7:15 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Photo-only walk-in service is Monday to Thursday, 8:00 a.m. to noon.
